correctness.rationale: For n=6t+r, powers 64^t and 729^t interpolate to restricted Z_7 series. Direct residue calculation gives 1+2^r+3^r congruent 3,6,0,1,0,3 mod7, so only r=2,4 matter. Dividing F_2 by 7 gives reduced H_2=2+6t mod7 with exact root t=-1/3 (nontrivial 7-adic cube roots sum to -1); uniform integral divided differences force v7(F_2)=1+v7(n). Dividing F_4 by 49 gives reduced H_4=2+6t²=6(t-3)(t-4) mod7 and exact distinct lifted roots t=-1/2 and -2/3, producing 2+v7(n-1)+v7(n). Coefficient divisibility bounds ensure reductions apply to ALL Z_7 arguments, and 7-adic Hensel simple-root factorization covers all n, not just sampled n. Period L_k=6*7^(k-1) follows from 64,729 congruent 1 mod7 and lifting; CRT gives counts R1=2,R2=8,Rk=15 (k>=3). Independent exact modular checks n=1..6999 and full periods k=1..5 matched; all-k result relies on proof.
